about.registryInfo: Monerium EMI ehf. — Icelandic electronic money institution authorized by the Financial Supervisory Authority of the Central Bank of Iceland and passported across the EEA; first company licensed to issue e-money on blockchains (2019). E-money is 1:1 backed in segregated, unencumbered high-quality liquid assets and unconditionally redeemable on demand under the EU e-money framework; MiCA-compliant e-money token (EMT).
